double_charge: We found the duplicate charge on your account and have started a reversal. The extra amount should return to your original payment method within 3-5 business days.
wrong_amount: We are reviewing your bill against the agreed price. If an error is confirmed, we will issue a corrected invoice and refund the difference.
invoice_missing: We have re-sent your invoice to your registered email. You can also download it any time from Account > Billing > Invoices.
late_delivery: We checked with our shipping partner about your delayed order and have asked them to prioritise it. You will get an updated delivery date by email shortly.
lost_package: We have opened a trace with the courier for your missing package. If it is not located within 48 hours, we will send a replacement or refund you in full.
wrong_item: We will arrange a free pickup of the incorrect item and ship the right one to you at no extra cost. A return label is on its way to your email.
defective_product: We will replace the faulty product or refund you, whichever you prefer. Please reply with your order number and a short photo or video of the issue.
damaged_on_arrival: We will send a replacement right away at no cost. Please share a photo of the damaged item and its packaging so we can claim with the carrier.
not_as_described: We will review the listing against the product you received. You are eligible for a free return and full refund if it does not match the description.
app_crash: Please update to the latest version and restart your device. If it still crashes, reply with your device model and app version and our engineers will investigate.
login_issue: Please try the 'Forgot password' option and check your spam folder for verification codes. If you still cannot sign in, we will verify your identity and restore access.
slow_performance: We are sorry about the slow performance. Please clear your cache or reinstall the app; our team is also checking recent updates for performance regressions.
password_reset: We have sent a fresh password reset link to your registered email. It is valid for 30 minutes. If you do not see it, check spam or reply to this message.
account_locked: We have flagged your account for manual review and will unlock it once your identity is verified. This normally takes under 24 hours.
update_details: You can change your details under Account > Profile. If a field is locked, reply with the new information and we will update it after verification.
refund_delay: We have escalated your refund with our finance team. Refunds can take 5-10 business days to appear after the returned item is received and inspected.
refund_denied: We are re-examining your refund decision. A senior agent will review the case and contact you with a clear explanation or an updated outcome.
cancel_order: We have started the cancellation of your order or subscription. If it has already shipped, we will provide a return label and refund you after it is returned.
